items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: my father's name was James Augustus Wilson

ctx.x: So I guess that a good place to start would be back to my earliest recollections as a child back in Austin, Texas. I was born in Austin, Texas on November 24, 1912, and my father's name was James Augustus Wilson, my mother was Pearl Georgia Shaw, her maiden name.
When I was born, I had one older brother, a year and a half older than me, James Augustus, Jr., after my father -- we call him Gus. His nickname was always Gus for Augustus.
